body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-11-11 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "15% guidance is also going on, so I think it should be done" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth. Target: +15%. body: S.K. Tripathi (Deputy MD) on 2025-05-19 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "today on INR 1,500 crores, we have visibility to the extent of about 60% to 70%. And it should start coming out either in the June or in the quarter 2" Metric: Water receivables. Target: ~INR 900-1,050 cr recovered from Jun-25. Deadline: 2025-09-30. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Water receivables rose to INR 1,551 cr at Sep-25 (from 1,427 at Jun-25) despite INR 420 cr collected in Q2; still ~INR 1,600 cr in May-26 and ~1,500 cr billed+unbilled in Aug-26. FY26 collections INR 1,800 cr vs INR 2,500 cr invested. Explanation given: UP and Jharkhand JJM funding stalled at the centre (volunteered in Oct-25 opening: 'slow compared to our expectations')
